summary: Lockstep builds IDE copilots for mid-size engineering teams. Primary need is deterministic, reproducible code completions tied to commits and model versions; low-latency streaming for in-IDE completions; rollout/canary controls and CI-integrated eval gates.
timeline: 2026-02-10 — Intro call (AE Maya, SE Ethan). Flag: need deterministic outputs pinned to model+git-commit. Quote: 'We must be able to reproduce a suggestion that shipped with v1.2.3'.
2026-02-12 — Shared security checklist and SOC2 artifacts (drive). Legal asked about retention window and export controls.
2026-02-17 — Technical deep dive: discussed canary strategy (5% -> 25% engineers), rollback policies, and per-commit model pin mapping. SE to deliver POC design doc.

notes:
CRM notes / call fragments: 
- Use-case: in-IDE code completion + docs suggestions. Need sub-50ms token streaming for snappy UX; target p95 <75ms.
- Repro concerns: must tie model checkpoint + tokenizer + config to a git SHA; allow reproduce across infra (hosted vs dedicated).
- Rollout: canary -> staged -> full; want automated eval gates in CI that check suggestion acceptance and unit-test pass-rate on suggestion-applied code.
- Model/version pinning: require immutable model identifiers we can reference from product builds and release notes. Prefer model artifact hashes.
- Evals: will provide prompt/fixture sets (10k snippets) to verify regressions; require baseline vs candidate A/B and automatic rollback if drop >2% in accept-rate.
- Security: SSO/SAML + audit logs + KMS for keys. Residency: EU customers, so need region pinning.
- Cost: moderate sensitivity; open to dedicated reserved capacity but need predictability.
- Quote from engineering lead: 'If a model update changes completions for a shipped feature, we need a way to blame and revert—ideally without reverting code.'
- Action items: SE to send POC plan + cost estimate; infra to check on-prem packaging timelines.
next_meeting_objective: Run POC kickoff: install agent in 5 dev machines, start canary ingest, wire eval webhook to CI
